hypothesis: The s200 shared-H3 checkpoint can complete the observation-to-action server path and produce finite, non-constant, in-support actions for one fixed LIBERO episode without clean-future leakage.
single_variable: Replace the legacy H3-DreamWAM policy server with the shared-H3 chunk-causal sampler and its s200 checkpoint; keep the established LIBERO camera/state/action conversion and rollout harness.
parent_baseline: E20 fixed val40 chunk-causal generation: video/action MSE 0.627430/1.255442, improving 9.795%/0.270% over identical initialization.

references.title: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control

architecture.upstream_code: generate video chunk, cache it, generate action chunk, then advance
architecture.local: per chunk denoise video, commit clean video, denoise action, commit clean action
architecture.rationale: The local implementation recomputes full history instead of KV caching but exposes the same causal information.

data.upstream_code: LIBERO agent and wrist cameras plus proprioception
data.local: established two-camera preprocess, H3 VAE first-frame encode and 8D state
data.rationale: The rollout reuses the previously exercised LIBERO conversion path.

action.upstream_code: seven active normalized LIBERO dimensions decoded to environment convention
action.local: seven min-max decoded dimensions with gripper convention inversion and clipping
action.rationale: Round-trip conversion is unchanged from prior H3 rollout tests.

objective.local: one bounded engineering episode records success plus action/latency diagnostics
objective.rationale: The first server integration is deliberately too small for an effectiveness claim.

optimization.local: shared H3 tail-2 s200 after 1600 samples
optimization.rationale: This tests deployment feasibility before any request for longer training.

evaluation.local: libero_goal task3 trial0, max80, wait30, replan32, sample steps4
evaluation.rationale: A single fixed trial can validate the closed-loop path but cannot measure generalization.

evidence: shared H3 four-stream port plus explicit clean-key validity mask
v7 dense stats/context and existing LIBERO runtime
existing minmax and gripper round-trip implementation
E20 evaluates generated samples rather than teacher-forced velocity
checkpoint identity and s200 budget recorded
E20 sample40 completed with finite generated outputs
s200 restored for teacher-forced, masked and sample40 evaluation
no-leak sample40 improves video 9.795% and action 0.270%
this experiment is the first shared-H3 closed-loop canary

decision.rationale: Authorize exactly one bounded engineering rollout. Pass means the service becomes ready and returns finite, nonconstant actions through at least one replan; task success is recorded but not required for the engineering gate. Any nonfinite action, server error, observation leak or action-contract failure is an immediate stop.
